name: @foreverworks/mcp-home-assistant
description: MCP server for Home Assistant over its REST and WebSocket APIs: entities and their states, areas, history, the logbook, templates, and running actions, with locks, alarms, covers and valves confirmed

mcp.title: Home Assistant
mcp.tagline: Read your Home Assistant's states, areas and history, and run its actions, approving locks first.

HOME_ASSISTANT_URL.title: Home Assistant address
HOME_ASSISTANT_URL.description: The address you open Home Assistant at, such as http://homeassistant.local:8123.

HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN_FILE.title: Long-lived access token file
HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN_FILE.description: Path of a file holding a long-lived access token made in an administrator's Home Assistant profile.

HOME_ASSISTANT_CONFIRM_DOMAINS.title: Domains to confirm
HOME_ASSISTANT_CONFIRM_DOMAINS.description: Action domains you approve call by call, comma-separated (default lock,alarm_control_panel,cover,valve; none for none).

author: Forever Works
